name: "Flying Bird"
source:
A bounty hunter. An Indian girl wearing a shaman's outfit under her cloak. Quiet and wise.
Her tribe has already been relocated to an Indian reservation, but she alone remains in the West to appease the spirits that have recently begun to cause trouble in the streets. In today's West, calming a spirit is the same as capturing a bounty, so she has no trouble finding food. She is slightly struggling to find a place to live, though. Although she lacks frontal combat power, she has the ability of a shaman, making her an expert when it comes to dealing with spirits and monsters. She earns bounties (= calms spirits) much more efficiently than white bounty hunters who have to rely on silver bullets, crosses, or even heavy firepower.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=59081]Getchu[/url]]
